scenes.en: Quiz: which one means short sight?
scenes.say: Quick quiz. Minus two, or plus two. Which one means short sight? Answer in three seconds.

scenes.en: Near is clear, far is blurry. Called myopia.
scenes.ta: மைனஸ் என்றால் கிட்டப்பார்வை. தூரம் மங்கலாக தெரியும்
scenes.say: Minus power means short sight, called myopia. Near things are clear, but far things, like the board or road signs, look blurry.

scenes.en: The eye is a little too long, so light focuses in front of the retina.
scenes.ta: கண் சற்று நீளமாக இருப்பதால் ஒளி முன்னால் குவியும்
scenes.say: Why? The eyeball is a little too long, so light focuses in front of the retina. A minus lens spreads the light, so it lands in the right place.

scenes.en: Far is easier, near is a strain. Called hyperopia.
scenes.ta: பிளஸ் என்றால் தூரப்பார்வை. அருகில் பார்க்க சிரமம்
scenes.say: Plus power means long sight, called hyperopia. The eye is a little short, so close work is a strain. A plus lens adds focusing power.

scenes.en: Short sight is becoming much more common in children worldwide.
scenes.say: Did you know? Short sight is becoming much more common in children around the world. Studies show more time outdoors in daylight lowers the risk.

scenes.en: Kids outdoors every day. Check power yearly. Wear glasses as prescribed.
scenes.ta: தினமும் வெளியில் விளையாடுங்கள். வருடம் ஒருமுறை பரிசோதனை
scenes.say: So send kids outdoors every day, check eye power every year, and wear glasses as prescribed. If a child's power rises fast, see an eye specialist.
So the answer is minus two. Know your own power. Book an eye test today.
